name: Military OneSource — Resource Finder
description: A Department of Defense support hub with information and resources for service members and eligible families.
first_step: Browse the resource finder and confirm whether a service fits your situation.

name: Military OneSource — Food Assistance for Military Families
description: Official guidance on food assistance pathways, including SNAP, WIC, school meals, food banks, and military community support.
first_step: Review the listed programs and confirm eligibility and local availability with the official provider.

name: Military OneSource — Financial Counseling
description: Free financial counseling for eligible service members and family members, including help with budgeting, debt questions, and referrals.
first_step: Review eligibility and contact Military OneSource to ask about available counseling options.

name: Military OneSource — Military & Family Life Counseling
description: Information about confidential, short-term counseling and support for service members and eligible family members navigating stress, parenting, grief, and transitions.
first_step: Review the program details and use the official locator or contact options to confirm local availability.

name: Military OneSource — Deployment Support
description: Information to help service members and families prepare for and manage deployment-related transitions.
first_step: Review the available deployment support guidance and use the official contact options if you need help.

name: Military OneSource — Installation Directory
description: Official installation information that can help families begin researching services and local contacts at a duty location.
first_step: Search for the installation and verify details with the listed official office.

name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
description: Official VA portal for veterans, eligible family members, benefits information, and support services.
first_step: Choose the relevant topic and confirm eligibility and application steps on VA.gov.

name: USAJOBS — Federal Employment
description: The official U.S. federal government jobs website. Search roles and read each vacancy announcement for requirements.
first_step: Search for roles that match your skills and review the announcement before applying.

name: Military Spouse Employment Partnership
description: A Department of Defense initiative connecting military spouses with employers and career opportunities.
first_step: Explore employer and career resources and confirm current opportunities directly.
